newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: AsiaMatrix hits high on takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: AsiaMatrix hits high on takeover bid.

text.p: Shares in plastics injection maker AsiaMatrix Ltd rose 23 percent to a new year high of Singapore S$1.70 on Monday following a takeover attempt by private firm Silver Beads International Ltd, dealers said.

At 0220 GMT, the shares were around S$1.62, up 24 cents from its pre-suspension close of S$1.38 on June 27. More than 14 million shares changed hands early on Monday after trading resumed following Friday's announcement of the takeover bid.
"It's mainly speculative buying on the takeover news," a dealer with a local institution said.
The takeover bid from the British Virgin Island-registered Silver Beads would involve the sale of shares representing about 50.98 percent of AsiMatrix's share capital.
Silver Beads, together with several other parties, will buy 13.46 million AsiaMatrix shares at a cash price of S$1.45 each. The purchase is expected to be finalised today.
"Some retail puinters are buying up the stock but the upside should be limited with the takeover price set at S$1.45," another dealer said.
Dealers said the risk was minimal since OUB, the financial advisor to the purchasers, said it would make an offer to acquire the remaining 12.6 million shares, also at S$1.45 each.
